title: Microsoft Edge: Choose a Profile at Startup
description: Microsoft Edge is introducing a profile picker at startup, making it easier to begin each browsing session with the right profile. Users can choose among their work, personal, or other available profiles, add a new profile, or browse as a guest before opening the browser. This helps users keep their browsing data and activities in the intended profile, while the Show on startup setting lets them control whether the picker appears at launch.
